name: Furron
summary: ERADICATION's live battlefield is organized around seven named territories, starting at Whiskerhold and pushing through six Furry-held flags toward Whiskspire.
role: Use the map as a deployment and route-planning tool. Forward spawns only matter when your side owns the territory, so the safest route is usually the one that preserves nearby flags instead of overextending past them.
fun_facts: Whiskerhold is part of the map but does not count toward the reclaimed-territory objective.
Rush strips the battlefield down to Furrow instead of using the full seven-flag route.
